versions.content: service method TransferExit [SWS_UCM_00347] Upstream: RS_UCM_00019 , RS_UCM_00025 TransferExit (IN TransferIdType id) Finish the transfer of a Software Package to UCM. Scope service interface PackageManagement class mono Fire & Forget false class mono Version 1.0 Management class mono Parameter th Name th Richtung th Typ th Beschreibung td id td IN td TransferIdType td Transfer ID of the currently running request. Application Errors th Fehler th Beschreibung td kOperationNotPermitted td The operation is not supported in the current context. td kTransferIdInvalid td The Transfer ID is invalid. td kDataInsufficient td TransferExit has been called but total transferred data size does not match expected data size provided with TransferStart call. td kAuthenticationFailed td Package authentication failed. td kPackageFormatUnsupported td The Vehicle Package or Software Package archiving format is not supported. td kPackageInconsistent td Package integrity check failed. td kPackageVersionIncompatible td The version of the Software or Vehicle Package to be processed is not compatible with the current version of UCM or V-UCM. td kPackageManifestInvalid td Package manifest could not be read. td kSwclRemovalDenied td Attempt to remove PLATFORM_CORE Software Cluster. td kOldVersion td Software Package version is too old.
